name: Cat–Cow on the Carriage

load.note: Any light setting works — stay on whatever is already on if it feels supportive.

summary: On hands and knees on the carriage with the hands on the footbar or shoulder rests, round and arch the spine. A reset between harder blocks.
steps: Kneel on the carriage, hands on the footbar, knees under the hips.
Breathe out to round the spine, tail under, head heavy.
Breathe in to lengthen through to a gentle arch, chest forward.

layers.title: Glide
layers.text: Let the carriage slide back as you arch and in as you round.

cues:
Move one bone at a time.
Carriage stays still, or let it glide a little as you arch.
Shoulders away from the ears.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.

variations.name: Fists or forearms for sore wrists
